title: The Shunammite’s Land Restored

questions.question: Why did Elisha tell the Shunammite woman to leave?
options: The Lord has called for a famine
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord has called for a famine
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:1 (ESV): "...for the LORD has called for a famine, and it will come upon the land for seven years."

questions.question: How long did the famine last?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:1 (ESV): "...it will come upon the land for seven years."

questions.question: Who was talking to the king about Elisha's miracles?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:4 (ESV): "Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the man of God..."

questions.question: Who became king of Syria by suffocating Ben-hadad?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:15 (ESV): "...he took the coverlet and dipped it in water and spread it over his face... And Hazael became king in his place."

questions.question: Who began to reign in Judah in the fifth year of Joram king of Israel?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:16 (ESV): "...Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, began to reign."

questions.question: Where did the Shunammite woman go during the famine?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:2 (ESV): "...and she went with her household and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years."

questions.question: What happened while Gehazi was telling the king about Elisha raising the dead?
options: The woman appealed to the king for her house and land
questions.correctAnswer: The woman appealed to the king for her house and land
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:5 (ESV): "And while he was telling the king... behold, the woman... cried to the king for her house and her land."

questions.question: What did Elisha do when he saw Hazael?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:11 (ESV): "...until he was ashamed. And the man of God wept."

questions.question: Why did Elisha weep?
options: Because he knew the evil Hazael would do to Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Because he knew the evil Hazael would do to Israel
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:12 (ESV): "...Because I know the evil that you will do to the people of Israel..."

questions.question: Who did Jehoram marry?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:18 (ESV): "...for the daughter of Ahab was his wife. And he did what was evil..."

questions.question: How many camels' burden of good things of Damascus did Hazael take to Elisha?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:9 (ESV): "So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, all kinds of goods of Damascus, forty camels' burden..."

questions.question: Why did the Lord not destroy Judah despite Jehoram's wickedness?
options: For the sake of David his servant
questions.correctAnswer: For the sake of David his servant
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:19 (ESV): "Yet the LORD was not willing to destroy Judah, for the sake of David his servant..."

questions.question: Who revolted against Judah during Jehoram's reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:20, 22 (ESV): "In his days Edom revolted... Then Libnah revolted at the same time."

questions.question: How long did Jehoram reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:17 (ESV): "He was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem."

questions.question: Who succeeded Jehoram as king of Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 8:24 (ESV): "and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place."

key_verse_text: Yet the LORD was not willing to destroy Judah, for the sake of David his servant, since he promised to give a lamp to him and to his sons forever. (ESV)
